title: Decision record (BRIEF §9)
description: Append-only event records under decisions/<seq>-<slug>.yaml. DECISIONS.md and the digest are generated projections; truth is the fold of the records. A record binds to the artifact that enforces it; an unbound record is flagged 'unenforced' and must state why.

id.description: D<seq>, matching the filename's zero-padded sequence number.

tier.description: A: decide, record, proceed. B: provisional, veto_by required, proceed-unless-vetoed. C: owner-only; a record exists only to log the block and its resolution.

reversibility.description: What undoing this would cost, concretely.

status.description: Recorded status. Effective status is computed: a provisional record past veto_by is accepted-by-lapse (silence for one review cycle = consent, BRIEF §9); the record file itself is never edited to say so.

veto_by.description: Tier B only: end of the review cycle. Computed clocks live in the digest, not here.

type.description: file: target path must exist. config: 'path#dotted.key' must resolve in a TOML/YAML file. pytest: node id must collect and not be skipped. manifest: target path must be listed in MANIFEST.sha256.

detail.description: What about the target enforces the decision.

unenforced_reason.description: Required when bindings is empty: why no enforcing artifact exists yet (e.g. 'pre-M0'), and which future artifact will bind.

veto_procedure.description: Tier B: how the owner vetoes (default: say so in the weekly digest review).

risk_flags.description: BRIEF §9.1: flagged records always surface in the exception-only digest; unflagged ones auto-consent under a fresh attention receipt (minus a K=3 random sample).
